description: Raw conversation history baseline: keeps all messages sequentially, no retrieval filtering
Dense vector similarity baseline: top-k pure cosine similarity, no metadata signals or drift
Importance-based retrieval baseline: ranks memories purely by intrinsic importance score
Full ADAM system: all Phase 1-6 subsystems active (drift, hybrid, 6-signal ranking, budgeting, lifecycle)
ADAM without importance scoring: uniform 0.5 importance, zero importance ranking weight
ADAM without tier hierarchy: all memories in single flat tier, zero tier score bonus
ADAM without consolidation: writes all messages as new items, no duplicate/contradiction handling
ADAM without forgetting/decay: no Ebbinghaus decay, memories never purged
ADAM without adaptive query drift: retrieval always searches all tiers without scope narrowing
ADAM without multi-signal ranking: candidates ranked purely by hybrid score without recency, tier, access, or importance weighting
